purpose: Measure the multi-agent orchestration studio against the single agent that the repository ships, over the same cases and with the same snapshot, and publish the result whether it is a gain or a loss.
red_line: ADR-P007: the studio is off in the shipped configuration until this comparison measures a gain, and the verifier stays deterministic.
supersedes: orchestration_studio_v1, whose registration names a set that the correction of the corpus of the policies moved

denominator_rule: every case of the set is scored in both arms, and the denominator of every measure is the 31 cases of the set; a case that a run could not answer counts as a case that was not resolved and it is never left out of the denominator

rule: the two arms read the same ledger and the same cases; a comparison over two snapshots is a comparison over two questions

name: single_agent
description: The path that the repository ships: one agent of ledgerlens/agents/integrator.py with its six tools and the deterministic verifier of ledgerlens/verify/. The baseline of the comparison is frozen in docs/orchestration/baseline.md.

name: orchestration_studio
description: The experimental variant: a plan of steps dispatched to specialists under the budget of the run, with the same tools, the same verifier and the same model of each slot as the single agent. The variant never replaces the verifier and the verifier never becomes a model.

name: correct_cases
definition: The cases the arm resolved, with the oracle of the code that resolved them and never with a verdict that the module recomputed.

name: cost_per_correct_case_usd
definition: The money of the arm over the cases it resolved. A price that was never verified leaves the money unknown, and an unknown is never a zero.

name: latency_p95_ms
definition: The p95 of the latency of the cases of the arm, measured over the same run and with the same machine.

name: tool_calls
definition: The number of calls of the tools that the arm made over the 31 cases.

decision: The studio is a gain only when it resolves strictly more cases than the single agent over the same 31 cases, with a difference of at least 2 cases, and its cost per resolved case is not higher than the cost per resolved case of the single agent. A difference of 0 or 1 case is a trend and not a gain. A studio that costs more and answers the same is not a gain. When the money of an arm is unknown, the comparison of the money is not established and the flag stays off. The flag stays off in every other case, and the result is published either way.
flag_when_met: the flag of the studio may open for the experiment that is registered here and for nothing else

statement: One run per case over 31 cases makes the difference of the arms a trend and not a statistical significance. The page of the result publishes the interval of the difference of the correctness, and an interval that covers zero keeps the flag off. The threshold of 2 cases is a decision of the repository and not a significance, and the page says so.

The set of the comparison is registered in data/eval/datasets.json with the role held_out, so that only the final scoring of this comparison reads it. A tuning script that reads it is refused by the guard of the tuning, and nothing of the studio is tuned against the set of the comparison.
